
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lulight/p/19495544" title="发布于 2026-01-17 11:54">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【Azure APIM】如何解决后端API服务配置自签名证书时APIM请求报错500：Error occured while calling backend service</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>问题描述</h1>
<p>在博文“<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lulight/p/19479238" target="_blank">【Azure 环境】在Windows环境中使用OpenSSL生成自签名证书链步骤分享</a>”，我们通过OpenSSL已经创建了自签名证书PFX文件。&nbsp;</p>
<p>当把证书配置到后端API服务，并且通过APIM作为服务对外提供的网关入口后，发现客户端请求发送到APIM，但是APIM访问后端服务器时候，无法建立Https连接。报错500。</p>
<h2>访问流图</h2>
<p><img alt="image" width="999" height="224" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202601/2127802-20260117115648469-463224442.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>错误信息</h2>
<blockquote>
<pre><span style="font-size: 16px"><span style="color: rgba(255, 102, 0, 1)"><code class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="292"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">forward-request (356.754 ms)
{
    "messages": [</span></code></span><strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 102, 0, 1)"><code class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="292">
        "Error occured while calling backend service.",
        "The underlying connection was closed: Could not establish trust relationship for the SSL/TLS secure channel.",
        "The remote certificate is invalid according to the validation procedure."
</code></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 102, 0, 1)"><code class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="292"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    ]
}</span></code></span></span></pre>
</blockquote>
<h2>在开启APIM调试Trace后，可见错误信息</h2>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="407" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202601/2127802-20260117113549118-1332165675.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>面对这个问题，需要如何解决呢？</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>问题解答</h1>
<p>因为浏览器发起HTTPS请求后，服务器会返回它的证书信息到客户端进行验证。但由于使用的自签名证书的根CA，中间证书都不是受信任机构所颁发的证书，所以在操作系统中没有内置CA信息，所以被浏览器认为这是不受信任的证书。就直接中断连接，返回net::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID 错误。</p>
<h2>HTTPS证书验证流程图：</h2>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="599" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202601/2127802-20260117104554751-1523039935.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h1>当CA证书不受信任的时候，浏览器报错如下</h1>
<p>Your connection is not private</p>
<p>Attackers might be trying to steal your information from lbca.mylubu.com (for example, passwords, messages, or credit cards).</p>
<p>Learn more about this warning net::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Subject: </span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.mylubu.com

Issuer: My Self Intermediate CA

Expires on: Feb </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">29</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2028</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

Current date: Jan </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">17</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

PEM encoded chain:
</span>-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
MIIE3zCCAsegAwIBAgIUVoVVHuMRMxqelxTsX4OPtc3EnuUwDQYJKoZIhvcNAQEL
BQAwYTELMAkGA1UEBhMCQ04xEDAO<br>......</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
SxmYHLkIM</span>/VbtjWKixl7mKltQMwbUvRMW+vOkZu/ibEtyG+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">OfGBIA9InKqE0BSng
HNIRYgeO7r1AfMtLHUCy</span>+RmC6AueslBWqdSminThQD8HbY+YvGFU9/zduVRY/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Uic
3wFr
</span>-----END CERTIFICATE-----</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="366" loading="lazy" style="border: 2px solid rgba(0, 0, 139, 1)" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202601/2127802-20260117111326863-1062968700.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>如果对于本地客户端，解决方案就是把完整证书链的服务器证书PFX安装到本地就可以。当本地证书库中包含了这个服务器证书的中间证书，根证书后，浏览器访问就会被信任。</p>
<h2>但是在APIM服务上，应该如何处理呢？</h2>
<p>根据官方文档 “<a href="https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/api-management/api-management-howto-ca-certificates" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">如何在 Azure API 管理中添加自定义 CA 证书</a>”的介绍，APIM服务支持上传CA证书。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>在AIPM的证书管理页面，因为我们的服务器证书是一张包含根证书，中间证书，服务器证书的完整证书链证书，所以心想，是否可以直接上转这一张证书就可以了呢？</p>
<p><span style="font-size: 15px"><strong>实验证明，不可以！</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 15px"><strong>错误实验第一步：上传服务器证书到CA Certificates</strong></span></p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="88" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202601/2127802-20260117113745399-682063516.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 15px"><strong>错误实验第二步：访问APIM接口，错误依旧</strong></span></p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="244" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202601/2127802-20260117113702457-1406789204.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 15px"><strong>正确实验，按照要求，先后上传了根CA，中间CA证书。再次访问APIM接口，获取200返回，问题解决，自签名证书验证成功。</strong></span></p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="471" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202601/2127802-20260117114147786-2079407710.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>注意：</strong>在上传证书页面，只支持cer和pfx格式证书(<code class="code-line code-active-line" dir="auto" data-line="405">File extension for rootCA.crt is not present in the allowed file extensions list - "cer,pfx")。</code>所以openSSL生成的.crt 证书可以通过Windows中双击打开文件后，选择导出为CER证书。</p>
<p>1: 双击 rootCA.crt&nbsp;</p>
<p>2: 选择 Details 项</p>
<p>3: 点击Copy to File 按钮，在弹出的窗口中直接点击Next</p>
<p>4: 默认选择第一个 DER encoded binary X.509 (.CER)</p>
<p>5: 点击 Next， 在新一个窗口中选择 CER文件的保存路径。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="999" height="366" loading="lazy" style="border: 2px solid rgba(0, 0, 139, 1)" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202601/2127802-20260117114631803-1757111356.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
